test_robot_arm_sensor_observables: test the RobotArmSensor class to verify joint position and velocity observables return correct values
test_sensor_with_torque_sensors: test the RobotArmSensor with torque sensors enabled to verify JOINT_TORQUES observable is present
test_sensor_without_torque_sensors: test the RobotArmSensor with torque sensors disabled to verify JOINT_TORQUES observable is absent
verify_observable_values: verify sensor observable values match expected joint positions and velocities using numpy assert_allclose
run_robot_arm_sensor_tests: run the absltest parameterized test suite for RobotArmSensor with and without torque sensor configurations
